facts.fact: Statistics Mauritius released online on 30 June 2026 its first-quarter 2026 labour force estimates from the Continuous Multi-Purpose Household Survey (CMPHS), a national household survey covering all private households in Mauritius and Rodrigues, run monthly since 2005 with about 11,280 households sampled a year.

The document says the 2022 Housing and Population Census results were used to review sampling strata from 2023 and to revise the population figures behind the labour force estimates; no enumeration date is given, so the year is used.
